links.outcome: Agreement with ground truth in conformal-prediction certain versus uncertain outputs
links.effect: Certain outputs had significantly higher AUROCs across multiple findings (P < 0.05) and greater semantic similarity to reference impressions (P < 0.001); an independent LLM evaluator agreed (P < 0.001).
links.quote: Across both pipelines, outputs classified as certain demonstrated significantly higher agreement with GT than uncertain outputs.

unlisted_practices: Conformal prediction to stratify VLM radiology report outputs into certain and uncertain subgroups

screen.practice: conformal prediction uncertainty flagging of draft outputs
screen.reason: Empirical benchmark testing conformal prediction as a model-agnostic uncertainty estimation and risk-stratification safeguard for automated radiology report generation.
